# Scene millford — contract

## Places
- Mill Yard — the yard above the stopped wheel; the dry race is visible from it
- Ferry Landing — the bank where the ferry sank; rope stub on the post
- Burnt Barn — a barn with half a roof, straw inside

## NPCs
- Aldo — the miller; stands in the Mill Yard by day, at the landing at dusk
- Neska — the ferrywoman; works the boat, sleeps in the barn

## Props
- Cut Rope — the ferry rope, cut short, under the straw in the Burnt Barn
- Grain Sacks — sacks stacked in the Mill Yard, some already sour

## Sounds
- MillWheelDry — wood knocking with no water under it, in the Mill Yard
- FerryWater — slack water against a hull, at the Ferry Landing

## Events
- FerryRaised — raised when the boat comes up; the crossing opens
- BargeBought — raised when the barge is paid for; the grain store empties
